'''League of Legends Championship Pacific 2025 Mid-Season''' is the second Pacific League of Legends split under the LCP banner, with eight Pacific teams compete for the LCP title.

==Format==
* '''Regular Season'''
**8 teams play a Single Round Robin
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
**Top 6 teams advance to the playoffs
* '''Playoffs'''
**Double Elimination
** Rounds 1 and 2 matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
** All remaining matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Top two teams qualify for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2025|MSI]] and [[Esports World Cup/2025|EWC]]
* All matches are played under {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}} rules after receiving positive feedback on this format during Split 1.
